comparison.objective: Orient a gel tray crosswise to seal its end gaskets and place a comb in an end slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Tray orientation, gasket seating, and slotted comb insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Tray is crosswise with both end gaskets sealing and the comb seated in an end slot; no numeric seal or pose tolerances supplied.
comparison.reason: Fixture setup and insertion do not test bimanual hammering, manufactured-notch fracture, damage-limited withdrawal, or fragment collection.
